facts.text: Incoming freshman applicants to the Grove School of Engineering must have completed at least three years of high school math and science, and must be prepared to start calculus upon entry.

sources.title: Undergraduate: Admission | The City College of New York
sources.quote: Successful freshman applicants to The Grove School of Engineering will have completed a college-preparatory high school program including the following high school courses: Minimum of three years of science (preference given to those who have taken physics and chemistry)

sources.title: Undergraduate: Admission | The City College of New York
sources.quote: All students must be prepared to begin taking mathematics at the calculus level upon admission
